Journey

Discover the Journey

A small seed. A bright path.

Forest Seed Journey is a calm, tactile physics puzzle for players who enjoy a thoughtful challenge. Pull back, choose an angle, and let the forest carry your seed toward its goal.

20 LevelsFour chapters of hand-crafted woodland puzzles.
3 DewdropsFind the best route and collect every drop.
Living ObstaclesUse mushrooms, vines, rays, and webs to change your path.
Play at Your PaceA focused, single-player forest escape.

From seed to bloom

Find your path through the forest.

Every launch is a small decision. Every dewdrop brings the flower closer to life.
